# Block displacement

Corrupted-video blocks: random rectangles of the image jump sideways, with a little channel separation. Blocks change a few times a second; bursts switch on and off at most 1.5 times a second.

<EffectDemo effect="block-displacement" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { blockDisplacement } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/block-displacement';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(blockDisplacement({ preset: 'subtle' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.amount = 0.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                 | Default    | Range      | Description                                       |
| ------------ | -------------------- | ---------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `amount`     | number               | `0.5`      | 0 – 1      | How far blocks move.                              |
| `blockSize`  | number               | `24`       | 4 – 128 px | Height of a block; widths vary around twice this. |
| `density`    | number               | `0.2`      | 0 – 1      | Fraction of blocks that move.                     |
| `colorShift` | number               | `0.008`    | 0 – 0.05   | Red/blue separation inside moved blocks.          |
| `rate`       | number               | `6`        | 1 – 20 /s  | How often blocks change.                          |
| `trigger`    | 'bursts' \| 'always' | `'bursts'` |            | Glitch in random bursts, or all the time.         |
| `seed`       | integer              | `1`        | 0 – 9999   | Changes the random sequence.                      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`    | `density: 0.08`, `amount: 0.3`                                                        |
| `corrupted` | `trigger: 'always'`, `rate: 2.5`, `density: 0.35`, `amount: 0.7`, `colorShift: 0.015` |
| `chunky`    | `trigger: 'always'`, `blockSize: 64`, `density: 0.2`                                  |
| `fine`      | `trigger: 'always'`, `blockSize: 8`, `density: 0.25`, `amount: 0.4`                   |

Apply one with `blockDisplacement({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`density: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Cost:** 10.5 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/block-displacement`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Random block offsets keyed by a hash of block and time step.
